deprecation.message:
Original VirtualClient package is exceeding NuGet limit 250MB. Starting v2.0.1-beta, we are publishing the following separate packages per platform-architecture instead: 
- VirtualClient.linux-arm64
- VirtualClient.linux-x64
- VirtualClient.win-arm64
- VirtualClient.win-x64

description: Runtime platform for executing a wide-range of benchmark and customer-representative workloads on a system.
title: VirtualClient
